gyms.name: GoClimb (Bauman Moscow State Technical University climbing centre)
gyms.notes: University climbing centre with a separate bouldering hall (about 160 m2, 4 m high, MoonBoard); the site lists weekday evening hours 18:30-21:30 only and a 450 RUB visit for adults 18+. No map pin on the site and no dates (it mentions 2015 additions), so currency is unconfirmed. Category would be university.

gyms.name: Vosmerka (Skalodrom 8), Gurzufskaya
gyms.address: ul. Gurzufskaya 48, 4th floor (Reebok CrossFit EKB hall), Yekaterinburg
gyms.notes: Site says free climbing is possible as bouldering or with a rope. The footer reads 2014-2022, so current opening is uncertain. The contacts page embeds two Google maps (56.825632, 60.562783 dated 2017; 56.788155, 60.508000 dated 2022) but they are not labelled with the two addresses, so they were NOT used as pins.

gyms.name: Vosmerka (Skalodrom 8), Akademika Sakharova
gyms.notes: Second site of the same network; same caveats as the Gurzufskaya entry (footer 2014-2022, two unlabelled map embeds not used as pins).

gyms.name: Rock and Wall, Cherkasskaya rope hall
gyms.notes: Second branch of the operator of ru-026. The site calls it the difficulty (rope) hall: about 120 m2 of walls, over 10 m high, 12 top-rope points, daily 10:00-22:00. Bouldering is at the Radishcheva hall (ru-026). The site map shows only the Radishcheva pin, none for this branch.

gyms.name: ParkRock (Skalodromy Anny Dyatkovskoy)
gyms.address: Moskovskoye sh. 4 str. 3, behind the Skala shopping centre, Samara
gyms.notes: Site says visitors can climb routes on top or lower belay (100+ routes) and boulder (150+ routes); daily 10:00-22:00 by appointment, current price list. The contacts page loads a Yandex constructor map whose coordinates could not be read (the constructor API returned an error); no other pin on the site.
